title: CNN selection leads to spectroscopic confirmation of a Euclid strong lens
summary: Five convolutional models ranked Euclid early-release images, followed by human visual grading. Spectroscopy and lens modeling support EUCL J081705.61+702348.8 as a strong lens, with foreground redshift 0.335 and lensed source redshift 1.475. The 97 visually graded candidates are not 97 confirmed lenses, and model ranking alone did not establish the lens.
ai_technology: Ensemble of five convolutional neural networks

evidence.tested: Primary v1 and journal paper report spectroscopically supported lens with redshifts and lens modeling.
evidence.unknown: Earlier object reporting and aliases remain open; human visual grading and spectroscopy contributed to confirmation.
evidence.ai_role: CNN ensemble ranked candidates for human grading and spectroscopic follow-up.

source_review.scope: Primary source checked for identity, date, model role and bounded reported result.
